additional_info.body:
Dear Michael Frenger,
We hope this message finds you well.
We are writing to inform you about a recent update regarding your charging session, Our system initiated a
ZVT Partial-Reversal
for your transaction, which has been successfully processed.
What Happened:
During the session, our backend detected an inconsistency in the payment response from the terminal. Although the transaction was initially successful, the system did not receive the complete expected response format. As a result, a
partial reversal
was automatically triggered to ensure accurate billing.
What This Means for You:
A portion of the transaction amount has been refunded.
The charging station was reset to restore normal operation.
No further action is required from your side.
We apologize for any inconvenience this may have caused and appreciate your understanding. If you have any questions or need further clarification, please feel free to reach out to our support team.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Ankita
